{{Quote|Walk.|A Circling intercepts bowlcarrier Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Circling ring''' of the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]] was a wide ring formed by the homes of the [[Circling of the Red]]&mdash;the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Queen of the Red]]'s advisers and [[Reproduction/Legends|breeders]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the [[Quesoth]] [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]], who held a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], left the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] [[Palace (Red City)|Palace]] to go [[Trevik's home|home]]. While walking to [[Gender/Legends|his]] residence, he visited the Circling ring, and noted that the sky was [[Color/Legends|blue]]. A [[Unidentified Circling|Circling]] intercepted him and brought him to a [[Midli]]&mdash;the caste which oversaw the Workers&mdash;residence.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Circling ring appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', also written by Zahn.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
